messages:
Dina: Heads up — after yesterday's kernel swap to fast_rope_v2 I'm seeing a p50 regression on the mixtral-moe hostpool. Baseline p50 (seq=128, batch=8) ~= 22ms -> now ~38ms. KV cache miss-rate jumped ~3x. Anyone else noticing hotspots?
Mateo: I saw the alert at 10:04 UTC, digging into router logs now. Early signal: top-k routing is skewed — same prefix -> 1-2 experts repeatedly.
Jen: Can you paste a quick flame/profile or kernel selection trace?
Dina: pasted a condensed sample from pprof (truncated):
```
func:router_dispatch 45%
  -> select_topk 28%
  -> kv_cache_lookup 12% (evictions spike)
kernel_selector:fast_rope_v2 chosen for 74% of requests
```
perf-bot: Profiling snapshot uploaded: https://perf.redwood/snap/2487654321 — alloc/p50/p95 charts.
Omar: quick A/B tried on a small canary: lower topk from 4 -> 3 and cap per-expert inflight to 64. Results: p50 dropped to ~26ms, p95 from 320ms -> 210ms, KV eviction/sec down ~45%.
Mateo: interesting — could be that fast_rope_v2 changed head/kv alignment heuristics, increasing KV aliasing under our sharding. Also check softmax temperature on router; higher temp increases routing noise.
Nik: FYI I landed a heuristic yesterday: use_rope_scaled=true in kernel selector; it biases toward fast_rope_v2 for long seqs. Might be interacting badly with our expert sharding map.
Lucy: Suggestion: roll back kernel selection to legacy_rope for mixtral-moe pool while we tune heuristics, keep the other batching improvements.
Dina: I ran a canary with kernel=legacy_rope + topk=3 + inflight_cap=64 + router_temp=0.8. Measurements (canary traffic): p50=24ms, p95=190ms, kv_miss_rate ~ baseline +5% (vs +300% before).
Mateo: OK that's promising. Ops: we should add an adaptive fallback: if per-expert queue length > 80 for >10s, force per-request topk-- and route to alternate expert set. Keeps tail bounded.
Jen: I'll add a runtime flag and an alert: expert_queue_length > 80 -> trigger throttle. Also add tracepoints for kernel selection decisions.
infra-bot: Scheduled canary rollout of kernel=legacy_rope, routing.topk=3, expert.max_inflight=64 for pool mixtral-moe-canary at 15:10 UTC.
Dina: Thanks — after rollout monitor p50/p95, kv_evictions/sec, and per-expert queue-length heatmap. Will post updates in 30m. :thumbsup:
Mateo: Also let's capture a few representative traces with seq=64/128/256 to validate RoPE scaling impacts across head dims. Might reveal where fast_rope_v2 mispredicts kernel choice.
Omar: noted — I'll run synthetic sweep and upload traces to the same perf snapshot.
Dina: Great. If rollback stabilizes, we can re-enable fast_rope_v2 behind a stricter heuristic that considers expert_shard_hotness before selecting it.
Lucy: +1 — and add a short-term mitigation doc to runbook: fallback knobs and thresholds.
Dina: Copy that — will update runbook and ping infra when metrics look stable.
